sentences.text: 2. Learned AGP waives service of notice for State.
Learned counsel Mr. R.J. Nirmal waives service of notice for respondent no.1.

3. Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the reference Court has awarded the compensation exorbitantly ignoring the factors provided in the Land Acquisition Act for determining the price of the land.
It is a matter of fact whether the compensation has been correctly determined or not.
However, the money decree has been passed.
Therefore, a blanket stay could not be granted.

In view of the facts and circumstances of the case, there shall be an interim stay to the execution and implementation of the impugned judgment and award, on the condition to deposit the entire compensation with this Court within twelve (12) weeks from today.
